messages.subject: filter-off fixed effect
parts:
Hi,

this may be quite a simple question but I am new to iNLA and I don't know how to do it. I have solved a disease mapping model with spatial (bym2), temporal (rw2), spatio-temporal interacions (type IV) and fixed effects. The thing is I want to filter the effect of just one of the fixed effects once the model is solved but I don't know how to do that in a simple way. In other words, from the formula of the linear predictor I would like to subtract beta*variable(it). Is there any easy way of doing that?

Thanks in advance.
